final: WITH g AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), f AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(avg_amt) AS freq_avg FROM g GROUP BY frequency) SELECT g.account_id, g.frequency, g.avg_amt, g.avg_amt / f.freq_avg AS ratio FROM g JOIN f ON f.frequency = g.frequency ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
